topology_reasoning.how_it_works: Two parallel single-mode guides use mirrored smooth S-bends to reduce their center-to-center spacing over the middle of the footprint and then restore the original spacing. The close parallel region provides evanescent coupling while the guides remain distinct and do not cross.
topology_reasoning.geometry_choice: Each guide is a smooth centerline assembled from mirrored cubic Bezier-like transitions, then extruded with a constant-width cross-section on layer (1, 0).

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive-only recreation: two mirrored sampled gf.Path centerlines extruded at constant width; fitted the supplied center-spacing profile with outer_spacing=2.35 um, coupling_spacing=0.96 um, approach_length=8.0 um, and coupling_length=2.0 um.
